name: Prophetic Resonance

phase_0.boundary_condition: The eschatological horizon where temporal sequence meets eternal presence

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state of the prophet before the reception of the signal

TANCH.justification: The absolute closure of the prophetic cycle where all utterances are fulfilled

AFWD.justification: The directed movement of the message from the source toward the recipient

AREV.justification: The backward movement of memory to recover the original intent of the vision

CLINK.justification: The chaining of individual symbols into a coherent prophetic narrative

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential witness who is both the observer and the medium of the message

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the prophetic potential into realized fulfillment and deferred warning

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of divergent timelines into a single historical outcome

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state where the prophecy matches the event

EVALF.justification: The negative state where the signal is lost or the warning is ignored

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous presence of the already and the not yet

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of the vision into an unalterable record

phase_3.void_description: The unuttered word before the inception of the vision
phase_3.true_description: The alignment of the temporal event with the eternal decree
phase_3.false_description: The rejection of the prophetic signal by the historical subject
phase_3.both_description: The state of apocalyptic tension where judgment and mercy coexist

steps.domain_action: The prophet enters the state of receptive silence
The seer recognizes their role as the vessel for the resonance
The initial frequency of the vision descends from the source
The frequency binds to specific cultural and linguistic symbols
The vision branches into the path of the promise and the path of the woe
The path of the promise is explored through affirmative imagery
The promise moves toward its historical manifestation
The promise is recorded as a permanent covenant
The sequence returns to the branch point to evaluate the alternative
The path of the woe is explored through cautionary imagery
The woe is traced back to its root in human error
The warning is recorded as an unalterable judgment
The promise and the woe are synthesized into a single providential arc
The seer holds the tension of the paradox within the vision
The vision is structured into a final sequential message
The entire prophecy is sealed in the permanent record of the scroll
The seer confirms the integrity of the received signal
The prophetic cycle reaches its terminal boundary

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The subconscious archetypal filter of the seer
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Resonant harmonic coupling between the temporal and the eternal
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The collective unconscious and the akashic record
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The kairological timing of the cosmic clock
phase_5.alfs_store: The canonical scriptures and foundational myths of the culture

phase_6.cycle_cost: The psychic energy and physical vitality of the prophet
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A state of historical uncertainty and spiritual noise
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A state of structured destiny and clarified signal
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy consumed in the vision is balanced by the reduction in historical ambiguity
